opportunities.softwareEngineer.title: Software Engineer
opportunities.softwareEngineer.summary: We are looking for a Software Engineer to develop scalable and high-impact solutions in an agile environment.
opportunities.softwareEngineer.descripti: As a Software Engineer, you will be part of a multidisciplinary team responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining applications that serve millions of users. We expect you to actively collaborate in technical discussions, propose improvements, and help elevate the quality of our deliveries.
opportunities.softwareEngineer.requireme: Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience.
Previous experience with web application development in agile environments.
opportunities.softwareEngineer.responsib: Design and implement new features in existing applications.
Collaborate with product, design, and QA teams to deliver quality solutions.
Home office allowance and flexible hours
opportunities.softwareEngineer.cultureFi: We seek proactive people with a thirst for continuous learning.
opportunities.dataScientist.title: Data Scientist
opportunities.dataScientist.summary: We are looking for a Data Scientist to extract valuable insights from large volumes of data and develop predictive models.
opportunities.dataScientist.description: As a Data Scientist, you will be responsible for analyzing complex data, developing machine learning algorithms, and creating visualizations that guide strategic company decisions.
opportunities.dataScientist.requirements: Master's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or related field.
Experience with Python, R, SQL, and data visualization tools.
opportunities.dataScientist.responsibili: Develop machine learning models to solve business problems.
Create dashboards and reports to communicate insights to stakeholders.
opportunities.dataScientist.cultureFit.0: We value analytical thinking and scientific curiosity.
opportunities.dataScientist.cultureFit.1: We seek data-driven and results-oriented professionals.
opportunities.productManager.title: Product Manager
opportunities.productManager.summary: We are looking for an experienced Product Manager to lead the development of innovative products and guide product strategy.
opportunities.productManager.description: As a Product Manager, you will be responsible for defining product vision, prioritizing features, and working with multidisciplinary teams to deliver solutions that meet user needs.
opportunities.productManager.requirement: Minimum 5 years of product management experience in technology companies.
Knowledge of agile methodologies and product management tools.
opportunities.productManager.responsibil: Define product roadmap and prioritize features based on data.
Collaborate with engineering, design, and marketing teams to launch products.
We seek visionary leaders with user focus.
We value clear communication and ability to influence without authority.
opportunities.uxDesigner.title: UX/UI Designer
opportunities.uxDesigner.summary: We are looking for a creative UX/UI Designer to create exceptional digital experiences and intuitive interfaces.
opportunities.uxDesigner.description: As a UX/UI Designer, you will be responsible for user research, creating wireframes, prototypes, and final designs that provide memorable experiences for our users.
opportunities.uxDesigner.requirements.0: Degree in Design, Visual Arts, or equivalent experience in UX/UI.
opportunities.uxDesigner.requirements.1: Portfolio demonstrating digital design projects and user experience.
opportunities.uxDesigner.responsibilitie: Conduct user research and create personas and user journeys.
Develop wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs.
opportunities.uxDesigner.benefits.1: Budget for design software and equipment
opportunities.uxDesigner.cultureFit.0: We value creativity and attention to detail.
opportunities.uxDesigner.cultureFit.1: We seek empathetic designers focused on the user.
opportunities.backendDeveloper.title: Backend Developer
opportunities.backendDeveloper.summary: We are looking for a Backend Developer to build robust APIs and scalable systems.
opportunities.backendDeveloper.descripti: As a Backend Developer, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining backend services, RESTful APIs, and integrating with databases and external services.
opportunities.backendDeveloper.requireme: Solid experience with Node.js, Python, or Java.
Knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases.
opportunities.backendDeveloper.responsib: Develop and maintain RESTful and GraphQL APIs.
opportunities.backendDeveloper.cultureFi: We value clean code and good development practices.
We seek developers oriented by quality and performance.
opportunities.mobileEngineer.title: Mobile Engineer
opportunities.mobileEngineer.summary: We are looking for a Mobile Engineer to develop native and hybrid applications for iOS and Android.
opportunities.mobileEngineer.description: As a Mobile Engineer, you will be responsible for creating high-quality mobile applications, implementing innovative features, and ensuring an excellent user experience on mobile devices.
opportunities.mobileEngineer.requirement: Experience with native iOS (Swift) and/or Android (Kotlin) development.
Knowledge of React Native or Flutter is an advantage.
opportunities.mobileEngineer.responsibil: Develop native and hybrid mobile applications.
Collaborate with designers to implement intuitive mobile interfaces.
We value innovation and mobile user experience.
We seek engineers passionate about mobile technology.
opportunities.qaEngineer.title: Quality Engineer
opportunities.qaEngineer.summary: We are looking for a Quality Engineer to ensure the excellence of our products through automated and manual testing.
opportunities.qaEngineer.description: As a Quality Engineer, you will be responsible for developing testing strategies, automating QA processes, and ensuring our products meet the highest quality standards.
opportunities.qaEngineer.requirements.0: Experience in manual and automated software testing.
opportunities.qaEngineer.requirements.1: Knowledge of tools like Selenium, Cypress, or Playwright.
opportunities.qaEngineer.responsibilitie: Develop and execute comprehensive test plans.
Automate tests and integrate with CI/CD pipelines.
opportunities.qaEngineer.cultureFit.0: We value attention to detail and critical thinking.
opportunities.qaEngineer.cultureFit.1: We seek professionals committed to quality.
opportunities.systemsArchitect.title: Systems Architect
opportunities.systemsArchitect.summary: We are looking for an experienced Systems Architect to design scalable architectures and guide strategic technical decisions.
opportunities.systemsArchitect.descripti: As a Systems Architect, you will be responsible for defining the technical architecture of our products, guiding development teams, and ensuring our solutions are scalable and maintainable.
opportunities.systemsArchitect.requireme: Minimum 8 years of experience in software development and architecture.
Deep knowledge of cloud computing (AWS, Azure, GCP).
opportunities.systemsArchitect.responsib: Define scalable and secure system architectures.
Guide technical teams and review architectural decisions.
opportunities.systemsArchitect.cultureFi: We value technical vision and leadership by influence.
We seek architects with a growth mindset.
opportunities.cloudEngineer.title: Cloud Engineer
opportunities.cloudEngineer.summary: We are looking for a Cloud Engineer to manage and optimize our cloud infrastructure.
opportunities.cloudEngineer.description: As a Cloud Engineer, you will be responsible for implementing, monitoring, and optimizing cloud solutions, ensuring high availability, security, and performance of our systems.
opportunities.cloudEngineer.requirements: Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
opportunities.cloudEngineer.responsibili: Implement and maintain scalable cloud infrastructure.
Monitor performance and optimize cloud costs.
opportunities.cloudEngineer.benefits.0: Cloud certifications paid by the company
opportunities.cloudEngineer.benefits.1: Access to cloud labs for experimentation
opportunities.cloudEngineer.cultureFit.0: We value automation and operational efficiency.
opportunities.cloudEngineer.cultureFit.1: We seek engineers focused on reliability and performance.
opportunities.securityEngineer.title: Security Engineer
opportunities.securityEngineer.summary: We are looking for a Security Engineer to protect our systems and data against cyber threats.
opportunities.securityEngineer.descripti: As a Security Engineer, you will be responsible for implementing security measures, monitoring threats, and responding to security incidents to protect our infrastructure and data.
opportunities.securityEngineer.requireme: Experience in cybersecurity and vulnerability analysis.
Knowledge of security tools (SIEM, IDS/IPS, firewalls).
opportunities.securityEngineer.responsib: Monitor and respond to security incidents.
opportunities.securityEngineer.cultureFi: We value vigilance and defensive thinking.
We seek proactive professionals in data protection.
opportunities.devopsEngineer.title: DevOps Engineer
opportunities.devopsEngineer.summary: We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to automate processes and improve development and deployment efficiency.
opportunities.devopsEngineer.description: As a DevOps Engineer, you will be responsible for implementing CI/CD pipelines, automating infrastructure, and collaborating with development teams to accelerate deliveries.
opportunities.devopsEngineer.requirement: Experience with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions).
Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible).
opportunities.devopsEngineer.benefits.1: Access to premium tools and platforms
We value automation and continuous improvement.
We seek engineers focused on efficiency and collaboration.
opportunities.frontendDeveloper.title: Frontend Developer
opportunities.frontendDeveloper.summary: We are looking for a Frontend Developer to create modern and responsive user interfaces.
opportunities.frontendDeveloper.descript: As a Frontend Developer, you will be responsible for implementing designs into code, optimizing web application performance, and ensuring an excellent user experience.
opportunities.frontendDeveloper.requirem: Solid knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern frameworks.
Experience with React, Vue.js, or Angular.
opportunities.frontendDeveloper.responsi: Develop responsive and accessible user interfaces.
Collaborate with designers to implement mockups into code.
opportunities.frontendDeveloper.cultureF: We value creativity and attention to visual details.
We seek developers passionate about user experience.
